summary: This is an 8-K filing by First Mid Bancshares, Inc. reporting the execution of a $19.7 million promissory note with Bankers Bank. The note refinances an existing obligation, bears fixed interest at 6.125%, requires 38 monthly payments of ~$161,000, and has a final balloon payment due September 2029. It is secured by a negative pledge on the stock of the bank subsidiary. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
